title: 第20章 丹王心得第21章 检测天赋
content_zh:
随着境界的提高，下品灵气丹对陆沉的帮助越来越小。
五十枚下品灵气丹嗑完，仅达到炼体境八重巅峰。
又在郊外的几座大山吸了几天灵气，才勉强突破炼体境九重。
下品灵气丹蕴藏的灵气，已经满足不了陆沉的需求。
即使再嗑一千枚，也突破不了真元境。
陆沉面色凝重，若不能突破真元境，他只有两条路。
第一条是死路！
参加招生大典，直接被周若雪打死！
在百香楼，周若雪假装去拉他，手中有真元，意图不轨。
他全力一指，才堪堪点开周若雪的手。
而当时，周若雪只是随意出手，并没尽力。
可想而知，周若雪的修为有恐怖，绝对远超过他。
若不是在大庭广众之下，周若雪有所顾忌，就有可能将他当场斩杀了。
就算不参加招生大典，周鹤和周若雪也不会放过他，不会给他翻身的机会。
第二条是跑路！
跑路是不可能跑路的，这辈子都不可能跑路。
宁愿被打死，也不跑路！
如果陈元良没及时带回灵石，那他就只有死路一条了。
接下来的每一天，陆沉都跑到大山吸一遍灵气。
灵气再稀少，也是灵气，能吸多少是多少，好歹对提升修为有帮助。

炎阳指练到极致中的极致，没有任何提升，继续练习只是浪费时间。
陆沉就去琢磨那些古符文，看能不能从古符文之中，挖掘出可以增强实力的方法。
事实上，符文非常有用，比如铭文、炼器、符箓等等，其核心就是符文。
而且，陆沉记忆中的符文非常古老，奥义极深，比当代的符文强大得多。
可惜双木城没有铭文师、没有炼器师，也没有符箓师，否则陆沉就可以打这方面的主意。
其实，陆沉最想要的是，如何把古符文用自己身上
但那套古佬文有很多内容，愣是没有用在人体上的内容。
他琢磨了好些天，都参悟不出一个所然来。
终于，在招生大典的前一天，陈元良回来了。
当陈元良跑到陆家找陆沉的时侯，陆家上下都震惊了，连大长老都赶过来招呼。
都知道陆沉会炼丹，也得到丹馆的尊重，是丹馆的贵宾。
可谁也没想到，那个高高在上的丹馆馆主，会上门拜访陆沉。
而且，陈元良还没有一点架子，对陆家任何人都客客气气。
content_en:
As his level increased, low-grade spiritual energy pills were of less and less help to Lu Chen.
After finishing fifty low-grade spiritual energy pills, he only reached the peak of the eighth level of body refining realm.
After a few days of inhaling spiritual energy from several mountains in the suburbs, he barely managed to break through to the ninth level of the body refining realm.
The spiritual energy contained in low-grade spiritual energy pills could no longer meet Lu Chen's needs.
Even if he smokes a thousand more, he still won't be able to break through to the True Yuan realm.
Lu Chen's face was solemn. If he couldn't break through the True Yuan realm, he had only two options.
The first one is a dead end!
Participated in the admissions ceremony and was beaten to death by Zhou Ruoxue!
In Baixiang Tower, Zhou Ruoxue pretended to pull him away, holding true energy in her hand with evil intentions.
He pointed with all his strength before he could open Zhou Ruoxue's hand.
At that time, Zhou Ruoxue just took action at will and did not try her best.
It is conceivable that Zhou Ruoxue's cultivation level is terrifying, definitely far beyond him.
If Zhou Ruoxue had not been scrupulous in public, she might have killed him on the spot.
Even if he didn't attend the admissions ceremony, Zhou He and Zhou Ruoxue would not let him go or give him a chance to turn around.
The second option is to run away!
It is impossible to run away, not even in this life.
I would rather be beaten to death than run away!
If Chen Yuanliang didn't bring back the spirit stone in time, he would be dead.
Every day that followed, Lu Chen went to the mountains to inhale the spiritual energy.
No matter how rare the spiritual energy is, it is still spiritual energy. As much as you can absorb, it will help improve your cultivation.
The Yanyang Finger has been practiced to the extreme, without any improvement. Continuing to practice is just a waste of time.
Lu Chen went to study those ancient runes to see if he could find ways to enhance his strength from them.
In fact, runes are very useful, such as inscriptions, weapon refiners, talismans, etc., the core of which are runes.
Moreover, the runes in Lu Chen's memory are very ancient, have profound meanings, and are much more powerful than contemporary runes.
It's a pity that there are no inscription masters, weapon refiners, or talisman masters in Shuangmu City, otherwise Lu Chen could have made plans in this regard.
In fact, what Lu Chen wants most is how to use the ancient runes on himself
But there is a lot of content in that set of ancient novels, but there is no content that is used on the human body.
He thought about it for several days, but couldn't figure it out.
Finally, the day before the admissions ceremony, Chen Yuanliang came back.
When Chen Yuanliang ran to the Lu family to find Lu Chen, everyone in the Lu family was shocked. Even the first elder came over to greet him.
Everyone knew that Lu Chen could make alchemy, and he was respected by the alchemy hall and was a distinguished guest of the alchemy hall.
But no one expected that the high-ranking owner of the alchemy hall would come to visit Lu Chen.
Moreover, Chen Yuanliang has no airs and is polite to everyone in the Lu family.
